verified_facts.text: The hotel is set on 140 acres in Gardiner, New York.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set on 140 arcadian acres in Gardiner, New York

verified_facts.text: The accommodations are free-standing cabins with views of the Shawangunk Ridge.
verified_facts.excerpt: free-standing cabins framing clear views of the mighty Shawangunk Ridge

verified_facts.text: Cabins and cottages have floor-to-ceiling windows with bedside views of the wildflower meadows and private patios with lounge areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows allow bedside views of the wildflower meadows and open to private patios with lounge areas.

verified_facts.text: The Ridge Suites include indoor and outdoor fireplaces and a cedar hot tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: indoor and outdoor fireplaces, and a cedar hot tub create a retreat

verified_facts.text: The Two-Bedroom Connecting Cottages are described as suited to families, multigenerational travel or small groups.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ideal for families, multigenerational travel or small groups seeking space to gather.

verified_facts.text: An overnight stay includes Mercedes-Benz vehicles for local exploration.
The hotel can accommodate up to two dogs for a one-time pet fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: We can accommodate up to two dogs with a one-time pet fee.

verified_facts.text: Clay serves breakfast, lunch and dinner with a rustic New American menu built on seasonal vegetables grown locally and onsite.
verified_facts.excerpt: Serving breakfast, lunch and dinner, the rustic new American menu pairs seasonal vegetables grown from local farms and onsite in clay rich soils

verified_facts.text: The Great Porch is an open-air venue serving coffee and pastries in the morning and cocktails before dinner.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mornings begin with relaxed coffee and pastries, the afternoon brings light, shareable bites before evolving into a destination for pre-dinner cocktails.

verified_facts.text: Dew Bar is a poolside bar that opens seasonally from Memorial Day to September 30th, weather permitting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open seasonally from Memorial Day to September 30th, weather permitting.

verified_facts.text: Guests can join complimentary 45-minute wellness classes offered daily.
Guests can reserve the tennis and pickleball courts and use complimentary balls and rackets.
verified_facts.excerpt: reserve the courts at your leisure and enjoy our complimentary balls and rackets

verified_facts.text: The 140-acre property was a former tree nursery, and a dairy farm before that.
verified_facts.excerpt: purchased the 140-acre former tree nursery (and a dairy farm before that)

verified_facts.text: Wildflower Farms is a working farm.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wildflower is, as its name suggests, a working farm

verified_facts.text: There is a natural playground with a small zipline and a network of trails through the woods and meadows.
verified_facts.excerpt: There’s also an extensive trail network through the woods and meadows, and a natural playground with a little zipline.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not have a kids' club.
The hotel is reached along a long dirt road.
